programme.title: Mitchell Pehlke Lacrosse Show
programme.desc: Welcome to Episode 24 (Season 3) of the Mitchell Pehlke Lacrosse Show presented by Duke Cannon! In this episode, the guys break down the Cannons' Homecoming Sweep in Boston, discuss the big issue for the Atlas with the No. 1 pick, preview Palms vs. Charm in the inaugural WLL Championship, and take a look ahead to USA vs. Canada in an upcoming qualifier for the World Championship. Denver Outlaws LSM Jake Piseno also joins the show for an interview.
